name.zh: SledPack 无杆背负软翼风筝相机

coords: body frame: f forward along ski heading, l left, u up; metres; relative to the shared bodyPoints() pelvis point

carry.type: the OPEN kite rides flat on the rider's back; no pole, no sleeve, no funnel; nothing above the shoulders

sail_on_back.keelNoseSeats: two orange magnetic seats on the shoulder straps (≈0.62 m above the eyelet)

eyelet.what: small stiff tab with an orange ring on the hip belt behind the buttocks (≈0.5 m above the snow in a carving crouch), seat-harness style — not a pole
eyelet.why: line passes ≥1 m from the helmet at ≤55–60° elevation

lumbarModule.contents: two-drum reel (main + depower), 2S 18650 120 g heated, MCU/IMU/GNSS/baro, tension/angle eyelet sensor, 38 N weak link + cutter, charging contacts at the apex seat

carry.led: status LED on the left shoulder strap; one strap button = session arm / manual stow
carry.foldIntoPack: by hand: roll the sail round its two keels with the pod (Ø55 × 0.50 m) and put it in a pack; then the whole device is ≈2.5 L

kite.type: single-skin sled, two longitudinal carbon keels, bridle V to the apex, drogue tail

pod.camera: 48 MP gyro-EIS (30 g, 3.2 W), 66° lens, tilted 8° up from the line toward the rider's upper body; lens 0.12 m below the line

kite.tail: drogue cone, CdA 0.05 m², 1.2 m tail line

lines.depower: 0.20 mm white → trailing edge (last 5 % of stroke flags the sail)

lengthSchedule.rule: L = clamp(6 + 0.75 × (estimated apparent wind − 12 m/s), 5, 12) m, 2 s smoothing
lengthSchedule.meaning: farther and higher when fast and windy, closer and lower in light air (same flying angle, so height ≈ L·sin55°: ≈4 m … ≈10 m)

steering.estimate: left/right lines from the pack with differential pull: +1 drum and motor ≈25–30 g, ≈+15–20 USD BOM, four lines through one eyelet (twist risk up), and a sled steers poorly (would need a steerable kite shape); commandable span not simulated → fixed angle (user accepted)

timing_s.tailwindLimit: no launch / early retrieve above ≈6 m/s estimated tailwind (not enough lift to keep it behind)

phases.zh: 展开背在背上：翼尖扣在肩带磁座，线从臀后腰带小环出；没有杆，没有东西高过肩
phases.en: Carried open on the back: keel noses in shoulder-strap seats, line from a small ring on the hip belt behind the buttocks; no pole, nothing above the shoulders

phases.zh: 蹬出约 1 s 判定起滑并估算相对风；估计顺风 >6 m/s 时留在背上
phases.en: ≈1 s after push-off the ride is confirmed and the apparent wind estimated; above ≈6 m/s tailwind it stays on the back

phases.zh: 磁扣松开，风筝先落进身后尾流，放线离开尾流后吃风爬升（约 2 s 开始拍）
phases.en: The seats release; the kite drops into the wake behind the back, climbs once paid out into clean air (filming after ≈2 s)

phases.zh: 线长随相对风 5–12 m：快和风大时更高更远，弱风时更近更低；泄力线控拉力约 14 N
phases.en: Line 5–12 m with the apparent wind: higher and farther when fast and windy, closer and lower in light air; the depower line holds ≈14 N

phases.zh: 减速：帆像旗一样塌下，趁人还在滑立即拉低，不让它飘过头顶
phases.en: Slowing: the sail flags and is pulled down while the rider still slides, so it never drifts over the head

phases.zh: 线从身后进来时收回贴到背上；停稳后贴不上就在身后约 2.5 m 雪面待机，下次出发从雪面再起飞；收工时手动收
phases.en: If the line comes in from behind it is laid back onto the back; once stopped it waits on the snow ≈2.5 m behind and relaunches from there; stowed by hand at the end

doNotClaim: meets all 13 shared criteria (fails avail, jitter, azRange, packVol (flat envelope), headClear)
works in tailwinds (stays on the back above ≈6 m/s; tailwind avail ≈25 %)
the line is never near the head (in tail/cross winds it is within 1 m up to ≈21 % of riding)
it always lands back on the back (often it parks on the snow; final stow by hand)
